```{sage}
#| include: false
# Hidden setup for pages with 3D plots (mathkit or cjgg extension): loads
# show3d.py from the extension, which makes show() render 3D graphics as a
# Tachyon still plus an "Explore in 3D" link. See mathkit's README, "Sage 3D
# plots"; students never see this cell.
import pathlib as _pathlib
_here = _pathlib.Path.cwd()
_root = next(p for p in [_here, *_here.parents] if (p / "_quarto.yml").exists())
_found = sorted(_root.glob("_extensions/**/show3d.py"))
if not _found:
    raise FileNotFoundError("show3d.py not found under _extensions/: is the mathkit (or cjgg) extension installed?")
load(str(_found[0]))
```
